pokedexEntries.su: All the energy from Mega Evolution poured into the Shellder on its tail, leaving Slowpoke to be swallowed whole.

pokedexEntries.mo: When bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, Shellder converts into impregnable armor. There is virtually no change in Slowpoke.

pokedexEntries.us: Tremendous energy strengthened the power of the Shellder on its tail, but it doesn’t really affect Slowpoke.

pokedexEntries.um: Having been swallowed whole by Shellder, Slowbro now has an iron defense. It’s pretty comfortable in there, too.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Under the influence of Shellder’s digestive fluids, Slowpoke has awakened, gaining a great deal of power—and a little motivation to boot.
